Changes.LogName: Add Bentley's Restaurant Kiosk (placeable big craftable, indoors and outdoors)

{{ModId}}_RestaurantKiosk.Name: {{ModId}}_RestaurantKiosk
{{ModId}}_RestaurantKiosk.Description: An ordering kiosk from Bentley's. Right-click it to order from the Food Shop, the Dessert Shop or the Seasonal menu. Three kiosk-only deals a day: 10% off.

Changes.LogName: Add Restaurant Kiosk crafting recipe (learned at 2 hearts with Bentley)
Letter from Bentley about the kiosk
